image_description: A male Wood Duck (Aix sponsa) floating on calm water. The duck features a distinctive crested head with iridescent green and purple plumage, bold white stripes outlining the crest and eye, and a red eye. The body displays complex patterns of chestnut, cream, and black feathers. The reflection of the duck is clearly visible in the water below.
